title: Digital quantum lattice Boltzmann evolution by reversible compute and open-system reset
summary: Turbulent fluid simulation is computationally demanding because nonlinear interactions couple a wide range of scales. Quantum computing offers another computational model, but fluid evolution is nonlinear and dissipative whereas closed gate-based dynamics is linear and reversible. The lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) is an attractive discrete target because streaming is a local permutation, yet conventional collision reconstructs a nonlinear equilibrium and applies dissipative relaxation.
